description: This is a test class file for the AccessFlowStateMachineService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the service, such as getting allowed actions, workflow items, the next state, and CRUD operations on workflow state machine records. The tests use mock objects and sample data to verify the service's functionality.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineServiceTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the AccessFlowStateMachineService, verifying its behaviors such as retrieving, setting DAOs, querying allowed actions, actions, workflow items, next states, and performing CRUD operations, primarily using mock objects and test fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of the service and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Tests whether the service correctly returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineDao.

methods.name: testSetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Verifies setting a custom DAO in the service updates its internal DAO reference.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActions
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of allowed actions for specific flow, state, and role, using mocked DAO responses.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of allowed workflow items for specified flow, state, and role.

methods.name: testGetNextState
methods.description: Tests fetching the next workflow state given current flow, state, role, and action, including handling null result.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Tests retrieving states actionable by a user role for a given flow and set of actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Verifies saving a workflow state machine record through the service.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Verifies deleting a specific workflow state machine record.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsService
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple workflow state machine records for a flow, asserting count and correctness.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedService
methods.description: Tests the permission check for an action within a workflow given flow, state, role, and action.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific workflow item by its flow, state, role, and action.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Verifies deletion of workflow records associated with a specific user role.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Ensures proper handling of renaming a user role within workflow records.
